source: Each active version has its own nightly releases which are generated automatically. For more about enabling the Nuxt nightly release channel, see {0}the nightly release channel docs{/0}.
text: Chaque version active dispose de ses propres versions nightly, générées automatiquement. Pour en savoir plus sur l'activation du canal de versions nightly de Nuxt, consultez {0}la documentation du canal de versions nightly{/0}.
